title: Jazzy Canadian Blackeye Pea Fritters
description: A peppery and romantic Canadian dish featuring blackeye pea, these fritters are low-carb-friendly and perfect for a snack or dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, mash the blackeye peas using a fork or a potato masher until they are mostly smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, eggs, onion, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the dry ingredients to the mashed blackeye peas and stir until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 small patties.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat to 350 degrees.
Carefully place the patties in the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
